title: Vrex Barxt Qurat and Guardian of Destruction
summary: Break the Guardian and Barxt's bond while controlling destructive spirits and channelers.
overview: Break the Guardian and Barxt's bond while controlling destructive spirits and channelers.

roles.label: Everyone
tips: Assign Guardian, Barxt and add control separately. Prioritize channelers when they become vulnerable to reduce the periodic healing link.

phases.label: Guardian
phases.description: Fight the Guardian until Barxt enters.

phases.label: Destructive spirits
phases.description: Handle three waves, then clear every spirit to remove protection.

phases.label: Channelers
phases.description: Defeat the newly vulnerable channelers while managing melee resistance.

phases.label: Sever the bond
phases.description: Kill the Guardian first, then finish the spell-resistant Barxt.

sections.title: Encounter plan
bullets: At 70% Guardian health, active Barxt enters combat.
Barxt creates three waves of four destructive spirits at one-minute intervals. After the third, the bosses become protected until the spirits are cleared; spirit deaths also damage Barxt.
At 40%, Barxt gains strong melee resistance and the two channelers become attackable.
At 10%, his melee resistance ends and his spell resistances rise.
Destroy the Guardian before killing Barxt. Finishing Barxt while the Guardian remains causes the failure outcome and denies the normal reward sequence.

notes: Approval E387. Source review only; deployment, database spell lists and live balance have not been verified.
Barxt starts a tether_check timer but the handler tests tether; his own leash requires verification. The Guardian and channeler boundary checks are present.
